rationale: The agent processed an exchange without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, which violates the stated policy requirement to confirm before any write. While tool calls suggest the agent may have identified the user and relevant order (find_user_id_by_name_zip, get_user_details, get_order_details) and then executed the exchange (exchange_delivered_order_items), there is no explicit confirmation step prior to performing the exchange. The final message states the exchange has already been processed and includes refund/payment details, indicating a write occurred without prior user confirmation. Authentication appears minimal and implicit (name/zip lookup) but the key failure is the missing confirmation before making changes.
